title: Percona: TLS cert rotation (Vault re-issue + rolling restart)
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate percona`: per node (3 PXC + 2 ProxySQL), issues a fresh leaf via the node's own Vault token (pki_int/issue/percona-server), writes server-cert/server-key/ca.pem, and rolling-restarts the service.

observe.what: per-node old serial != new serial for all 5 nodes, error column empty (rolling, ~90s; PXC members one at a time so Galera tolerates each restart)

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.RotateCertAsync performs a genuine Vault re-issue + rolling restart across the PXC + ProxySQL tier.
